question: When is a person truly liberated rather than only partially liberated?
premises: A person may be liberated from one limitation while still remaining within another.
Such a person is therefore not fully liberated.
inference: Therefore only one who is free from every limitation is truly liberated.
plain_english: Thus, one who is liberated in one respect but still stands within another limitation is not truly liberated; only one free from all limitations is truly liberated.
